'Rise of the Penguins GB' is a 2D side-scrolling platformer for the Game Boy.
The game features simple controls and challenging gameplay with tough enemies.
'Rise of the Penguins GB' draws inspiration from classic games like Ghosts 'n Goblins and Mega Man.
The game includes 6 levels with a variety of enemies in each level.

fact_previews: The main goal of the Kickstarter project is to raise $300 to overhaul all of the backgrounds of the 6 main levels in the game.
The $300 goal will cover the costs to pay 1 artist to create all 15 backgrounds.
If there are remaining funds, additional backgrounds may be created.
The overhaul of the backgrounds aims to make the game look more professional and attract new audiences.
The stretch goal of $500 is to get the game on Steam for free.

A secret boss will be included for players who collect all the fish throughout the 6 main levels.
